content:
joel: Heads up, got alerted for a regional spike in mTLS handshake errors (alert 40) for svc-ingress -> svc-backend in ap-south at ~2026-04-02T04:21 UTC. Symptoms started right after RBAC schema change. Anyone seeing this?
priya: catching up now. any logs?
joel: snippet below — repeated across many pods: 
```
2026-04-02T04:21:17Z svc-ingress[pod-21] tls: handshake failure (alert 40)
keystore: fetch cert id=svc-backend-ap-south ttl=45s status=200 dur=280ms req_id=xyz-001
kms: decrypt key_id=projects/…/keys/keystore-ap-south status=429 rate_limit_exceeded quota=1000 QPS=1200 req_id=xyz-002
```
lee: RBAC migration log shows we removed broad "keystore:read" for legacy "platform-admin" and replaced with scoped roles. Looks intentional but might have narrowed service account perms.
infra-bot: RBAC change deployed by priya at 2026-04-02T04:18:45Z  change-id: rb-2468
priya: confirm I rolled the policy, but I targeted only control-plane. Maybe rule selectors matched more names than intended. Investigating.
joel: impact: TLS session setup cost rises because our proxies fetch certs live when cache miss; short cert TTL (45s) + many short-lived client connections -> KMS decrypt QPS spike and 429s -> handshake fails.
audit-bot: creating audit slice for rb-2468 and listing affected principals. attaching to INC-3331.
lee: quick mitigation options: 1) bump cert cache TTL to 20m, 2) add aggressive jittered backoff on keystore calls, 3) temporary KMS QPS bump request.
priya: I can roll a policy patch to re-allow svc-ingress SA in ap-south to read keystore entries while we fix selectors. But prefer a short-lived exception and then revert. thoughts?
joel: prefer non-RBAC emergency if we can buy time with cache TTL change. Rolling RBAC rollback could be risky during active deploys.
priya: agreed. I'll do the cache TTL hotpatch first. pushing small config change to config/proxy/ap-south: 
```yaml
PROXY_CERT_CACHE_TTL: 1200 # 20 minutes
KEYSTORE_RETRY_POLICY: exponential
KEYSTORE_RETRY_BASE_MS: 100
KEYSTORE_RETRY_MAX_MS: 5000
KEYSTORE_RETRY_JITTER: true
```
lee: deploy plan: canary 5 pods -> 5% traffic -> monitor handshake rate and KMS error rate. If canary looks good, roll to 50% then 100%.
kms-bot: KMS team notified (ticket KMS-777). Temporary quota bump request submitted.
priya: also adding a one-off audit log filter to check for any failed keystore ACL denies in last 30m.
audit-bot: filter saved: "keystore.access_denied" events for region=ap-south, timeframe=30m. returning 157 hits. listing top callers: svc-ingress-*, svc-sidecar-*.
joel: those denies align with the spike. OK proceed with canary. starting canary rollout now.
lee: canary metrics after 3m: handshake fail rate on canary nodes dropped from 9.8% -> 0.7%; KMS decrypt errors down 87%.
priya: great. will prepare a narrow RBAC selector revert to re-allow svc-ingress ap-south for keystore.read with an expiry annotation to auto-revoke in 1d. putting PR up: https://git.internal/rb/patches/349
joel: please also add postmortem tasks: - tighten deploy-time RBAC validation test, - add canary for RBAC changes, - add keystore TTL safety net to platform config so RBAC changes can't accidentally cause QPS storms.
lee: also recommend we add a gating rule: any RBAC delta that removes a role used by >N hosts must require a manual checklist signoff.
priya: ack. opening INC-3331 and attaching timeline + audit hits. will follow up with RCA doc.
kms-bot: KMS quota bump applied temporarily; monitoring for 15m.
joel: full rollout complete, handshake failures back to baseline. leaving incident open until RCA is published.
priya: starting RCA writeup, will include the RBAC diff, audit logs, and the small smoke test we ran.
audit-bot: ARC: note to teams  please avoid short cert TTLs for high-connection-rate services; document recommended TTLs and cache strategies.
joel: thanks all. closing loop once RCA posted in INC-3331. :thumbsup:
